clock_alignment: Canonical UTC sessions: hourly bars on the exact hour, daily sessions opening 00:00 UTC, weekly sessions Monday 00:00 UTC.

STOP_HOURLY.bar_close_rule: a 1h canonical session closes one interval after its start

STRATEGY_DAILY.bar_close_rule: a 1d canonical session closes one interval after its start

denominator_independence_rule: No universe predicate reads a comparison outcome. A timestamp can never enter or leave a denominator because the candidate and control outputs happen to agree or disagree.

ACTION_EVALUABLE_DECISION_TIMES.definition: Data-valid daily slots where both tracks produce a complete deterministic ordered action envelope from TRADE_ACTION_COMPARISON_OWNER_V1, whether flat or in position.

ALL_SCHEDULED_DECISION_TIMES.definition: Every slot the frozen epoch schedules, enumerated from the epoch bounds and the cadence alone.

CROSS_MARKET_CONFIRMED_STOP_EVENTS.definition: Stop-active hourly slots the frozen classifier labels CROSS_MARKET_CONFIRMED_STOP_EVENT.

DATA_VALID_DECISION_TIMES.definition: Scheduled slots where every required input for the consuming owner is present with available_at <= decision_time and the hard data-quality state is resolved for both tracks. A resolved hard failure is an owner output, not missing evidence.

ELIGIBILITY_EVALUABLE_DECISION_TIMES.definition: Setup-evaluable daily slots where both tracks have every input required by TRADE_ELIGIBILITY_COMPOSITE_OWNER_V1 and each produces a complete PERMITTED or NOT_PERMITTED result. Lifecycle state is an input to permission, not an exclusion: an open, closed or missed track is deterministically NOT_PERMITTED for a new entry.

GAP_THROUGH_STOP_EVENTS.definition: Stop-active hourly slots the frozen classifier labels GAP_THROUGH_STOP_EVENT.

ISOLATED_VENUE_STOP_EVENTS.definition: Stop-active hourly slots the frozen classifier labels ISOLATED_VENUE_STOP_EVENT.

POSITION_ACTIVE_DECISION_TIMES.definition: Slots where the track under evaluation holds an open position under the authoritative lifecycle owner.

REGIME_EVALUABLE_DECISION_TIMES.definition: Data-valid daily slots where both tracks hold the complete required regime score, smoothing and classification inputs.

SETUP_EVALUABLE_DECISION_TIMES.definition: Data-valid daily slots where both tracks hold the complete input set of all four authoritative setup detectors.

SIZING_EVALUABLE_DECISION_TIMES.definition: Slots that are trade-eligible in both tracks independently and where both authoritative INITIAL_POSITION_SIZE results are complete with a strictly positive position notional.

STOP_ACTIVE_EVALUATION_SLOTS.definition: Hourly slots where the control-reference track carries an active stop on an open position. The immutable control stop identity is the common event anchor for both candidate and control outcomes.

TRADE_ELIGIBLE_DECISION_TIMES.definition: Eligibility-evaluable slots where the track under evaluation permits a new entry under its own owners.

warmup_history.composite_inheritance_rule: A composite score is complete only when every required component is complete under its own owner's predicate. A composite invents no window of its own and never substitutes an elapsed-time proxy for a component's predicate.
warmup_history.evaluability_rule: A feature is evaluable at a decision when enough qualifying observations exist inside its owner's applicable trailing window AND every upstream initialization requirement is satisfied from point-in-time inputs. Elapsed time is never the test: elapsed_days >= a hardcoded longest warmup is neither necessary nor sufficient, and no such comparison may gate a slot.
warmup_history.pre_warmup_behavior: Raw point-in-time capture may build history only after both the corpus protocol and sufficiency-governance hashes plus POSTP1-004 have passed their required reviews. Until WARMUP_HISTORY_COMPLETE a slot is WARMUP_HISTORY_INCOMPLETE and enters no evaluable metric universe.

CVD_SPREAD.calendar_or_session_rule: PROSPECTIVE_CVD_ACQUISITION_V1 supplies the 1h acquisition grid; the feature owner supplies the observation count
CVD_SPREAD.evaluability_predicate: 20 prior common observations plus the current one exist with available_at <= decision_time, and neither side's history is degenerate
CVD_SPREAD.minimum_observation_count: 20 prior plus 1 current common spot/perp observation
CVD_SPREAD.rolling_window_span: 20 prior common observations; the owner specifies a window in observations and specifies no cadence
CVD_SPREAD.upstream_initialization: the z-score excludes the current observation from its own history, and both the spot and perp series must carry the same common timestamps

ETF_NORM_20D.evaluability_predicate: 20 complete publication days and a current AUM exist
ETF_NORM_20D.upstream_initialization: the latest point-in-time AUM is required

ETF_NORM_5D.evaluability_predicate: 5 complete publication days and a current AUM exist
ETF_NORM_5D.upstream_initialization: the latest point-in-time AUM is required

FLOW_ACCEL.evaluability_predicate: ETF_NORM_5D and ETF_NORM_20D are both complete
FLOW_ACCEL.upstream_initialization: none beyond the two source windows

FLOW_SCORE.calendar_or_session_rule: ETF publication days and exact UTC hours; the units are not commensurable and are not collapsed into one number
FLOW_SCORE.evaluability_predicate: ETF_NORM_5D, ETF_NORM_20D, FLOW_ACCEL, CVD_SPREAD and SPOT_DOMINANCE are each independently complete under their own owners
FLOW_SCORE.minimum_observation_count: every selected full-flow component complete at this decision
FLOW_SCORE.rolling_window_span: max(20 ETF publication days, 21 1h CVD observations, 30 hourly participation observations)
FLOW_SCORE.upstream_initialization: the participation growth series needs two equal windows before its own z-score history exists

FUNDING_7D_AVG.evaluability_predicate: at least one funding observation falls in (t - 7d, t]

FUNDING_ZSCORE_180D.evaluability_predicate: 30 prior funding observations fall in [t - 180d, t) and their variance is non-zero
FUNDING_ZSCORE_180D.upstream_initialization: the current observation is excluded from its own history

FUTURES_BASIS_AVG.evaluability_predicate: at least one basis observation is available at the decision

FUTURES_BASIS_ZSCORE_180D.evaluability_predicate: 30 prior basis observations fall in [t - 180d, t) and their variance is non-zero
FUTURES_BASIS_ZSCORE_180D.upstream_initialization: the current observation is excluded from its own history

HIGH_DISTANCE_52W.evaluability_predicate: 52 weekly observations exist in the trailing weekly window

MA_DISTANCE_20W.evaluability_predicate: 20 weekly closes exist in the trailing weekly window

MOMENTUM_12W.evaluability_predicate: a close exists at this session and at the session 84 periods earlier
MOMENTUM_12W.upstream_initialization: the current close plus the lookback close

MOMENTUM_4W.evaluability_predicate: a close exists at this session and at the session 28 periods earlier
MOMENTUM_4W.upstream_initialization: the current close plus the lookback close

OI_GROWTH_7D.evaluability_predicate: a current OI aggregate exists and an aggregate exists at or before t - 7d
OI_GROWTH_7D.minimum_observation_count: a current and a prior comparable observation
OI_GROWTH_7D.upstream_initialization: a prior OI observation at or before t - 7d is required

OI_GROWTH_ZSCORE_180D.evaluability_predicate: 30 prior growth observations fall in [t - 180d, t) and their variance is non-zero
OI_GROWTH_ZSCORE_180D.upstream_initialization: the earliest retained growth observation itself needs an OI observation 7d earlier

OI_INTENSITY.evaluability_predicate: the open-interest aggregate and the market-cap observation share an exact observation_time and both are available at the decision
OI_INTENSITY.minimum_observation_count: one open-interest aggregate and one market-cap observation at the same exact observation_time
OI_INTENSITY.upstream_initialization: the market-cap input is supplied by PROSPECTIVE_BTC_MARKET_CAP_ACQUISITION_V1 on the EXACT_UTC_DAY_START_00_00_00Z grid; a missing or late market-cap observation leaves the feature not evaluable

OI_INTENSITY_PERCENTILE_180D.evaluability_predicate: a current intensity exists and 30 prior intensity observations fall in [t - 180d, t)
OI_INTENSITY_PERCENTILE_180D.upstream_initialization: every historical intensity observation needs its own aligned open-interest and market-cap pair

ORDERLINESS_SCORE.evaluability_predicate: range_percentile, downside_return, liquidation_percentile and volatility_percentile are all present at this decision
ORDERLINESS_SCORE.rolling_window_span: none at this owner; the range, liquidation and volatility percentile inputs carry their own windows
ORDERLINESS_SCORE.upstream_initialization: the volatility-percentile owner and PROSPECTIVE_LIQUIDATION_PERCENTILE_ADAPTER_V1 must each be complete; an unavailable, late or invalid liquidation feed leaves the liquidation input missing and never zero

POSITIONING_SCORE.evaluability_predicate: FUNDING_HEALTH, OI_GROWTH_HEALTH and FUTURES_BASIS_HEALTH are each complete, and the configured leverage-health input is present
POSITIONING_SCORE.minimum_observation_count: 30 prior funding, 30 prior basis and 30 prior OI-growth observations in their own windows
POSITIONING_SCORE.upstream_initialization: the earliest OI-growth observation needs an OI observation 7d earlier

REGIME_SCORE.evaluability_predicate: every required component score is independently complete; the composite inherits their predicates and invents no window
REGIME_SCORE.minimum_observation_count: every required regime component complete at this decision
REGIME_SCORE.rolling_window_span: transitive maximum of the trend, flow, positioning and volatility component windows
REGIME_SCORE.upstream_initialization: the full model additionally requires the point-in-time macro, on-chain and liquidity inputs

REGIME_SMOOTHED_SCORE.evaluability_predicate: REGIME_SCORE is complete at this decision
REGIME_SMOOTHED_SCORE.rolling_window_span: current regime score and optional prior smoothed score
REGIME_SMOOTHED_SCORE.upstream_initialization: the owner deterministically initializes a missing previous smoothed score from the current score and records REGIME_SMOOTHING_PREVIOUS_SCORE_MISSING

RV_20.evaluability_predicate: 21 contiguous daily closes are available and all are strictly positive
RV_20.upstream_initialization: the first return needs the previous close

RV_60.evaluability_predicate: 61 contiguous daily closes are available and all are strictly positive
RV_60.upstream_initialization: the first return needs the previous close

RV_7.evaluability_predicate: 8 contiguous daily closes are available and all are strictly positive
RV_7.upstream_initialization: the first return needs the previous close

SPOT_DOMINANCE.calendar_or_session_rule: exact UTC hourly common spot/perp timestamps
SPOT_DOMINANCE.evaluability_predicate: 30 common observations exist and both growth z-scores are defined
SPOT_DOMINANCE.rolling_window_span: 5-period current and prior growth windows plus 20 prior growth values
SPOT_DOMINANCE.upstream_initialization: the growth series initializes only after two equal windows

STRUCTURE_SCORE.evaluability_predicate: the current structure, level and risk/reward inputs are all present at this decision
STRUCTURE_SCORE.upstream_initialization: the structural level and risk/reward owners must be complete

TREND_SCORE.evaluability_predicate: MA_DISTANCE_20W, HIGH_DISTANCE_52W and the selected momentum components are each independently complete under their own owners
TREND_SCORE.minimum_observation_count: every selected trend component complete at this decision
TREND_SCORE.upstream_initialization: the weekly structure and every component owner must be complete

VOLATILITY_SCORE.evaluability_predicate: every selected volatility component, VOL_PERCENTILE_2Y included, is complete under its own owner
VOLATILITY_SCORE.rolling_window_span: 730d eligible trailing RV window inherited from VOL_PERCENTILE_2Y
VOLATILITY_SCORE.upstream_initialization: each RV_20 result needs 21 contiguous daily closes (20 daily returns)

VOL_COMPRESSION_RATIO.evaluability_predicate: RV_7 and RV_20 are both complete and RV_20 is non-zero

VOL_PERCENTILE_2Y.evaluability_predicate: a current RV_20 result exists and at least 365 prior results fall inside half-open [observation_time - window, observation_time). The window span alone never implies completeness and 730 populated days are never required.
VOL_PERCENTILE_2Y.minimum_observation_count: 365 prior RV_20 observations inside that window, plus 1 current observation
VOL_PERCENTILE_2Y.rolling_window_span: 730d eligible trailing window, half-open [observation_time - window, observation_time)
VOL_PERCENTILE_2Y.upstream_initialization: each RV_20 result needs 21 contiguous daily closes (20 daily returns)

superseded_claim.claim: 750 calendar days is the exact owner-derived warmup
superseded_claim.correction: The owner keeps a 730-day eligible trailing window and requires 365 prior RV_20 observations inside it, never 730 populated days. Each of those RV_20 results needs 21 contiguous daily closes, so with contiguous daily observations the first evaluable decision is at session 386 (385 elapsed calendar days).
superseded_claim.why_it_was_wrong: It added the 730-day eligible trailing window to a 20-day upstream window as if both were required populated histories, and then used the sum as an elapsed-time evaluability test. The owner requires 365 prior observations inside the window, not 730 populated days.

three_distinct_quantities.minimum_contiguous_history_to_first_eval: A planning estimate under contiguous observations only. It is not the evaluability authority and no slot is admitted or refused by comparing elapsed time against it.
three_distinct_quantities.minimum_observation_count: The qualifying observations an owner requires inside its applicable trailing window. This, with the upstream initialization, is the evaluability authority.
three_distinct_quantities.rolling_window_span: The eligible trailing window an owner searches. It states which observations may count, never how many must exist.

vol_percentile_2y_derivation.statement: The owner keeps a 730-day eligible trailing window and requires 365 prior RV_20 observations inside it, never 730 populated days. Each of those RV_20 results needs 21 contiguous daily closes, so with contiguous daily observations the first evaluable decision is at session 386 (385 elapsed calendar days).
vol_percentile_2y_derivation.upstream_initialization: each RV_20 result needs 21 contiguous daily closes (20 daily returns)
